name: output-load-sensitivity
description: CHARACTERIZATION ONLY: Vref of the canonical bandgap_top vs a DC current sink at vref (exploratory -1..+2 uA sweep, 10 nA steps) at every process/temperature/supply corner -- unloaded baseline, signed shifts, slope at zero load. No spec threshold; not a load rating.
claim: CHARACTERIZATION ONLY -- no ratified spec row is claimed. Diagnostic evidence for the operator's open decisions on README.md row 'Load' (amendment A7: max DC load + load regulation, or explicit unbuffered/high-Z only) and on the PSRR row's load condition (amendment A4); see spec/tbd-row-evidence.md Row 3 and issue #269. The bench measures how far v(vref) of the current, unbuffered circuit moves when DC current is drawn from it; it sets no limit, selects no output stage and rates no load. The sweep span is an EXPLORATORY MEASUREMENT RANGE, not a supported-load range: a value inside it is not a statement that the block may be loaded that hard, and a value outside it is not a statement that it may not.

load_sweep.role: characterization-only; no spec threshold, no load rating, no accuracy budget
load_sweep.direction: positive iload = current SUNK out of vref into vss (the load draws current); negative = current sourced into vref. i(vlsense) carries the same sign and must equal the sweep value at every point.

units.current: A in the deck; reported in uA
units.voltage: V; unloaded baseline reported in V, shifts reported in mV
units.slope: dV(vref)/dI(sink) in V/A; reported in mV/uA (numerically kOhm). zout_kohm = -slope, positive when sinking lowers vref.

exploratory_range.label: EXPLORATORY MEASUREMENT RANGE -- not a supported-load rating
exploratory_range.why: Wide enough to show curvature and a few hundred mV of shift on the unbuffered node, fine enough (10 nA) to resolve the slope at zero load with a step-refinement check. Chosen from one tt/27 C/3.3 V operating-point probe of the current DUT (issue #269); it encodes no requirement.

load_sweep.baseline: unloaded vref = v(vref) at the sweep point where iload is exactly 0 A; the point must exist on the grid (|iload| <= 1e-6 * step), otherwise the corner is invalid -- never interpolated.
load_sweep.shift: signed shift_mv(I) = (v(vref)(I) - unloaded vref) * 1000 at each report point; negative means vref fell.

slope.method: central difference about iload = 0: s(m) = (v[k0+m] - v[k0-m]) / (x[k0+m] - x[k0-m]), m in grid steps
slope.why: |s(m) - s(1)| <= rel_tol * max(|s(1)|, abs_floor) for every m; a slope that moves with the step size is not resolved (insufficient resolution or a non-converged sweep) and the corner is invalid.

load_sweep.nonlinearity: nonlin_max_mv = max over the sweep of |v(vref) - vref0 - s(1) * iload| * 1000: departure from the zero-load tangent (recorded, not gated).

sweep_points.description: Not a spec check: asserts the sweep ran at the stated 10 nA resolution over -1..+2 uA (301 points), so the fixed indices above (baseline at [100]) mean what they say.

i_zero_check.description: Not a spec check: asserts index 100 is the unloaded (0 A) baseline point.

i_lo_check.description: Not a spec check: asserts the measured load current at the first point is -1 uA (sourced into vref) -- sign and units of the load convention.

i_hi_check.description: Not a spec check: asserts the measured load current at the last point is +2 uA (sunk out of vref).
